title: Early-1960s UAP event filmed at a military base

tellings.quote: evidence that that recorded that event happening and it happened at a military base

plain: Eric Davis, a physicist who has advised government studies of UFOs, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that an event involving an unexplained flying object in the early 1960s was recorded on film at a US military base. He brings up George H.W. Bush, later president, in connection with it, and tells it as proof that such evidence exists.
